answer: Each new identity must lock 40 POA in a lagoon escrow for 18 epochs and, once per epoch, publish a one-time echo of a challenge keyed to its join tx. Echoes are admitted only through a knoll board that issues 1 slot per identity and rejects a second slot if the join-key hash already reserved one. A farm of 200 aliases therefore posts 8,000 POA and still cannot get a second slot for a reused key; a detected double-echo burns the escrow and bans the key for 24 epochs.
